brands.manufacturer_name: NTC STAVEBNÍ TECHNIKA spol. s r.o. (IČ 63221152, DIČ CZ63221152)

supplier_notes: UNICON OSTRAVA s.r.o. (IČO 48391824, DIČ CZ48391824), Halasova 2999/8A, 703 00 Ostrava-Vítkovice, CZ; tel. +420 596 614 746, info@unicon.cz, https://www.unicon.cz, Mon–Fri 6:30–15:00. Founded 1993. It sells, services and rents construction machinery (70+ machines in its rental fleet). It is NOT the NTC importer. NTC is a Czech manufacturer selling directly. NTC's official partner map (ntc.cz/distributori) lists Unicon as an authorized NTC 'Dealer + Servis'. On unicon.cz it says it represents sales of Atlas Copco, Honda, NTC, Bomag, Cedima, Husqvarna, Hycon and Grindex, plus Fassi, Charvát CTS, Zepro, Medved and Piab. NTC products it sells: one- and two-way plates, rollers, joint cutters and rammers. NTC generators are not in its NTC menu but could likely be ordered. Bomag products: one- and two-way plates, rammers and a padfoot roller. The Bomag page does not say whether it is an authorized Bomag dealer. Lead times: not published by Unicon. NTC's own shop (ntcshop.cz) shows most core models 'Skladem (>5 ks)' with 1-day transit in CZ, so stock items should take a few working days. naradiestroje.sk quotes 1–3 working days for the Bomag BT 65. For pricing context, NTC's CZ list prices are excl. VAT on ntcshop.cz, and CZ dealers typically sell 0–15 % below list. NTC has its own SK sales rep (Ing. Petr Ratsam, +420 602 246 833, ratsam@ntc.cz) and SK dealers listed on ntc.cz (e.g. CEG s.r.o. Zlaté Moravce, Ing. Ján Buchanec Technik Martin, ŠTYL-IVANOV Vranov n. T.).
